name: loot
entries: Common — A dented brass lantern, three oil flasks, 8 gold, and a map whose destination has been scratched away.
Common — A balanced hand axe with a baker's mark, a coil of silk rope, and 11 gold sewn into the lining of a glove.
Common — Two healing potions, a silver whistle only dogs react to, and a key labeled "cellar three."
Common — A weatherproof bedroll, climbing spikes, dried rations, and a friendly letter addressed to the defeated enemy.
Common — A guard's shield painted over an older crest; cleaning it reveals the symbol of a disgraced noble house.
Uncommon — Boots that always remain dry but leave faint blue footprints for a minute after walking.
Uncommon — A collapsible ten-foot pole, a precision lockpicking kit, and a vial that turns red near fresh blood.
Uncommon — A moon-silver dagger that glows near curses but becomes painfully cold when one is very close.
Uncommon — A potion of borrowed voice that perfectly copies the last person heard for ten minutes.
Uncommon — A self-updating local map that records traveled paths but occasionally adds a road nobody remembers.
Uncommon — A sturdy medium armor bearing a removable rune socket and the name of a famous retired runesmith.
Uncommon — A purse containing 37 gold and one black coin accepted by a secret market.
Rare — A mirrored buckler that can reflect one beam or gaze effect before its surface cracks and needs repair.
Rare — A stormglass compass pointing toward the nearest active magical disturbance instead of north.
Rare — A seed in an iron vial; planted in soil, it grows into a sheltering tree before sunrise and withers at noon.
Rare — A cloak woven from dusk-moth silk that muffles movement in shadow but shimmers brightly in sunlight.
Rare — A runed gauntlet that can hold one non-living object weightlessly for an hour, but only while the fist stays closed.
Rare — A singing blade whose melody changes when its wielder is being deliberately deceived.
Rare — A sealed bottle containing a tiny thunderstorm and instructions written by someone with the party's handwriting.
Epic — The Crownless King's signet, recognized by ancient wards and by several factions with incompatible claims.
Epic — A phoenix-feather mantle that prevents one fiery death, then burns into an ordinary but beautiful cloak.
Epic — A door-shaped silver frame that opens once each month onto the last threshold it was carried through.
Epic — A rune-carved chain that can bind a magical effect for one scene if its user can name the effect precisely.
Legendary — The Last Cartographer's quill, able to draw a real path to any known place while erasing another road from the world.
Legendary — A cracked hour bell that stops everyone but its ringer for six heartbeats, while aging the ringer one visible year.
Curiosity — A wooden duck that insults whoever owns the most gold nearby and cannot be discarded for long.
Curiosity — A jar of argumentative fireflies that know many rumors but disagree about every detail.
Curiosity — An elegant spoon engraved with "for emergencies" that vibrates near soup, poison, and sleeping dragons.
Quest item — A bloodless severed shadow folded inside parchment, matching a living mayor who still casts one.
Quest item — Half of a treaty written in a dead language; the blank margins fill with new clauses during moonlight.
